name: toggle
summary: Renders a native Boolean checkbox styled as a switch.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned form needs one labelled Boolean checkbox presented as an on/off switch.
agent.avoidWhen: The state must update without submission, requires component-owned JavaScript, or needs a non-Boolean value.

invariants: Uses a native checkbox with value=true, role=switch, and native checked, required, and disabled attributes.
Optional id defaults to name; deterministic hint, error, and description IDs are reserved.
Name and ID are non-reserved safe tokens; label, hint, and error are nonblank control-safe plain text escaped as HTML.
A false checkbox follows native successful-control submission semantics; no hidden false field or fake transport is emitted.
The app owns form, submission, transport, routes, and domain validation. No JavaScript, commands, arbitrary attributes, or raw markup are emitted.
The fragment has exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], and [[description]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

Native command forms require a declared Bool carrier. The host maps an omitted enabled checkbox to false and binds a disabled checkbox to its declared state; the component introduces no hidden false field.
Native build, desktop/mobile browser, keyboard, no-JS, and rejected-draft proof lives in tests/browser/choice-native-proof.mjs.
